title: ReviewRuleProfilerOutput
description: Output schema for review-rule-profiler skill, defining rules and triggers for review-base

rules.description: List of path-specific review rules to be registered in review-base

triggers.description: List of review triggers binding repository file paths to specific rule IDs

RuleTriggerConfig.description: Trigger condition configuration for a review rule

types.description: PR event types that trigger this rule

paths.description: Glob patterns for files that trigger this rule when changed

pathsIgnore.description: Glob patterns for files that should be ignored (e.g. tests, fixtures)

draft.description: If false, the rule will not trigger on draft PRs

labels.description: Optional list of PR labels required to trigger this rule

ReviewRuleDefinition.description: A single specialized review rule definition

id.description: Unique identifier for the rule (kebab-case, e.g. 'rule-repo-api-security')

name.description: Human-readable display name of the rule

description.description: Brief description of the rule's focus and purpose

category.description: Classification category based on standard code review domains

instructions.description: Detailed Markdown instructions for the AI reviewer (must contain the 4 standard blocks)

triggerJson.description: Serialized JSON string of RuleTriggerConfig (used for direct DB seeding or legacy payloads)

enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled (true/1 or false/0)

ReviewTriggerDefinition.description: A trigger configuration linking repository paths to one or more rule IDs

name.description: Human-readable display name for the trigger

paths.description: Glob patterns of files monitored by this trigger

pathsIgnore.description: Glob patterns of files excluded from this trigger

ruleIds.description: List of rule IDs to execute when this trigger fires
